title: Session Tracker
prompt: Create a class Session with __enter__ returning the string 'open' and appending 'open' to a module-level list EVENTS; __exit__ appends 'closed' and returns False. After a with block, EVENTS must be ['open', 'closed'] even if the body raises.

tests.name: normal flow
tests.code:
global EVENTS
EVENTS.clear()
with Session() as s:
    assert s == 'open'
assert EVENTS == ['open', 'closed']

tests.name: cleanup on exception
tests.code:
global EVENTS
EVENTS.clear()
raised = False
try:
    with Session():
        raise RuntimeError('boom')
except RuntimeError:
    raised = True
assert raised, '__exit__ must not swallow the exception (return falsy)'
assert EVENTS == ['open', 'closed']
tests.hint: __exit__ must run even when the body raises — return False so the error still propagates.
